recipe_version.title: Puerto Rican Pollo Guisado with White Rice
recipe_version.description: Bone-in chicken browned and stewed in fresh sofrito with tomato sauce, homemade sazón of achiote, cumin, coriander, and oregano, potatoes, carrots, and briny olives with pimientos. Served over white rice.

ingredients.name: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs
ingredients.note: about 3 lb; skin removed if you prefer

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.note: leaves and tender stems, plus 2 tbsp chopped to garnish

steps.title: Prep and make the sofrito
steps.body: Stir the achiote, cumin, coriander, oregano, garlic powder, and 2 tsp salt together and rub half over the chicken. Pulse the onion, green pepper, cubanelle, garlic, and 1 cup cilantro in a food processor to a coarse paste. Cut the potatoes and carrots. Rinse the rice.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a 5-quart Dutch oven over medium-high. Brown the chicken in two batches, about 4 minutes per side, and transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Cook the sofrito
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Add the sofrito and the rest of the spice mix and cook, scraping the bottom, until fragrant and most of the liquid has cooked off, about 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato sauce for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.body: Add the potatoes, carrots, olives, bay leaves, and 1 1/2 cups water and stir, then nestle in the chicken.

steps.title: Stew
steps.body: Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer over medium-low until the chicken reads 175 F near the bone and the potatoes are tender, about 35 minutes. Uncover for the last 8 of those minutes to thicken the sauce.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: When the stew goes on to simmer, combine the rice, 2 1/2 cups water, 1 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Boil uncovered over high heat until small craters form on the surface and little liquid shows, about 5 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 20 minutes; rest covered 5 minutes. This runs inside step 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Remove the bay leaves. Spoon the rice onto plates, ladle the chicken, vegetables, and sauce beside it, and scatter chopped cilantro.
